A1.justification: Both complete 24-page PDFs describe the same HinFlow work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulation and physical-robot experiments, including benchmark comparisons, transfer experiments, ablations, and additional appendix analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the seven-task simulation evaluation and physical-robot results in Table 1.

M1.justification: The flow planner, policy architecture, hindsight relabeling procedure, training objectives, and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The revised task horizon does not introduce a method component.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same LIBERO and ManiSkill tasks, physical-robot task, cross-embodiment transfers, visual generalization scenarios, and appendix three-stage task.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: BC, ATM variants, and Online VPT remain in the main comparisons; UniPi, PPO, and HuDOR remain in Appendix C.4. The newly cited Luo and Du work is not evaluated.

E3.justification: Appendix B changes the stated Place Book episode horizon from 250 to 200. Other settings remain unchanged. This is a reported protocol revision; the PDFs do not establish whether it corrects documentation or reflects rerun experiments.

E4.justification: The demonstration-count and flow-length ablations are unchanged. The appendices retain the same generalization, multi-task planner, flow-noise, replay-buffer, and long-horizon analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions state five independent random seeds and mean-plus-standard-deviation reporting in Section 7. Figure 4 retains the same explanation of shaded standard deviations; no statistical reporting procedure changes.

E6.justification: Reported values, plotted curves, and qualitative findings are unchanged, including 84% average simulation success and Table 1's final 19/20 robot successes. The horizon revision is not accompanied by changed or additional results.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives in Sections 3–4, action-chunking formulation in Appendix A.1, and perturbation formula in Appendix C.6 are unchanged. No proofs or theoretical results are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about grounding flow plans through hindsight online imitation, sample efficiency, cross-embodiment learning, and visual robustness.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, including dependence on initial action-labeled demonstrations, ambiguity of 2D flows, and failures caused by inaccurate planner guidance.

D1.justification: Appendix C.1 removes the explicit statement that the five demonstrations per cross-embodiment task were collected through SpaceMouse teleoperation. The demonstration count remains five, and no replacement collection procedure is specified. This changes documentation without establishing an actual collection change.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds Luo and Du's Grounding Video Models to Actions through Goal Conditioned Exploration and explains its video-diffusion exploration alongside Zhou et al.'s vision-language goal proposals. The existing distinction between image goals and HinFlow's point flows is retained. The Liu reference update concerns the same work.

P1.justification: v2 locally expands the related-work paragraph, revises funding acknowledgments, adds corresponding-author designation, and updates publication and reference metadata. The overall organization and nearly all prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds an ICLR 2026 running header and horizontal rule, with limited text reflow around revised passages and references. Figures 1–22 and Tables 1–3 retain their content, design, captions, and placement.

improvement.justification: The added related-work discussion improves attribution, but Appendix C.1 loses a specific demonstration-collection detail. Appendix B also changes the Place Book horizon from 250 to 200 without explaining whether this corrects documentation or changes the experimental setup, while retaining all results. These mixed documentation changes leave the net quality effect uncertain.
